info.name: Construction BE API
info.description: API collection for Construction Management Backend (Node.js, Express, Prisma)

request.description: Register a new user. Only admins can create users with isHead: true, and only for ACCOUNTANT and STORE_INCHARGE roles. Users with isHead: true have access to all projects and sections.

Get users with filtering, searching, and pagination. Supports search in name, email, employeeId fields. Now includes userAnalytics object with role-based access control (RBAC) - Admin sees all users, Site Incharge/Project Manager see only users in their sections, CM/Store Incharge/Accountant see no other users.
Get projects with filtering, searching, and pagination. Supports search in name, code, description fields. Returns totalAmountSpent for each project and its sections based on POs with amounts.
Get project details by ID. Now includes materialCapAnalytics array with aggregated cap tracking across all sections, demand vs cap tracking, usage percentages, and status indicators.
Get sections with filtering, searching, and pagination. Supports search in name, code, description fields. Returns totalAmountSpent for each section based on POs with amounts.
Get section details by ID. Now includes materialCapAnalytics array with demand vs cap tracking, usage percentages, and status indicators.

item.name: Get Sections With Site Incharge Assignment Status

request.description:
Get all sections in a project with assignment status for a given Site Incharge user.

Response fields for each section:
- isAssigned: true if assigned to the given user
- assignedToCurrentUser: true if assigned to the given user
- assignedToOther: true if assigned to another site incharge in the project

item.name: Get Sections With Accountant Assignment Status

request.description: Get all sections in a project with isAssigned status for a given Accountant user.
Get materials with filtering, searching, and pagination. Supports search in name, description, category fields.

query.description: Search in name, contactPerson, email, phone, address

request.description: Get vendors with filtering, searching, and pagination. Supports search in name, contactPerson, email, phone, address fields.

query.description: Search in vendor name, contact person, or email

request.description: Get all vendor accounts with overview including balance, paid amount, remaining amount, overdue amount, etc.

item.name: Add PO Amount
item.description: Add amount to PO. Automatically changes PO status to CONFIRMED and credits vendor account. Only works for POs in CREATED status.

item.name: Get Users By Role For Assignment

query.description: Role to filter users by (e.g. PROJECT_MANAGER, SITE_INCHARGE, etc.)

request.description: Get users by role for assignment. Optionally filter by projectId for assignment logic.
Get role-specific dashboard analytics. Automatically returns data based on user's role and access level.

Get comprehensive admin dashboard analytics including: total projects, amounts spent/pending/paid, vendors, demands, POs, demand breakdown pie chart, PO distribution by vendor bar chart, financial progress per project grouped bar chart, users by role graph, and amount by vendor breakdown chart.
Get site incharge dashboard analytics for assigned sections only. Includes: total projects, amount spent, demands, POs, demand breakdown, PO distribution by vendor, and amount by vendor breakdown.
Get project manager dashboard analytics for assigned sections only. Includes: total projects, amount spent, demands, POs, demand breakdown, and amount by vendor breakdown.
Get construction manager dashboard analytics for assigned sections only. Includes: total demands, POs, and demand breakdown.
Get store incharge dashboard analytics for assigned stores only. Includes: total stores, materials, stock, reserved items, and assigned sections.
Get accountant dashboard analytics. Includes: total vendors, amounts spent/pending/paid, and top vendor accounts with balances.
Create or update material caps for a specific section. Uses upsert logic - creates new caps or updates existing ones. Each section can have only one cap per material.
Retrieve all material caps for a specific section. Returns caps with material details including name, unit, and category.
Update caps and remove caps not in the array. If a material is not in the array, its cap will be deleted. Returns both updated caps and deleted caps.
Get accumulated caps across all sections in a project. Returns aggregated caps by material and detailed caps for each section.

query.description: Search in material name, section name, project name

request.description: Get all material caps with pagination (admin view). Includes material, section, and project details.
